runtime_contract.placement: Exact authored placement only. No procedural scatter.
runtime_contract.collision: Semantic collision hints are non-authoritative. Initial catastrophe dressing is visual-only.
runtime_contract.history_layer: This family is aftermath/catastrophe dressing layered over surviving Meridian civic substrate; do not replace the surviving-city family wholesale.
runtime_contract.custodian_rule: Do not label generic salvage/repair props as explicitly Custodian-made unless an authored placement or evidence record establishes that provenance.
runtime_contract.compound_rule: review_required compound extracts may be used only as explicit authored set pieces, never generic variants.
